verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.19 relative to the control trajectory in the 12 months after 22 Jul 2020 (90% interval −0.21 to −0.14). Of 60 untouched cells given the same test, 0 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical and radar agree: greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.19 and radar backscatter (VV) rose by 3.8 dB (combined placebo p = 0.03).
